items.title: Long-term Amazon Redshift observability with Datadog and Amazon S3 Tables
items.summary: Amazon Redshift keeps only 7 days of system table history. This post pairs Datadog Data Observability with the new Amazon Redshift system table integration with Amazon S3 Tables, so you can retain query history for the long term and analyze lineage, query performance, and data quality without adding load to your warehouses.
items.creator: Raghu Kuppala
